blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Brooke Van Sickle showed flashes of her MVP form in her comeback from a shoulder injury, leading Nxled past PLDT, 25-16, 25-20, 25-18, in the PVL All-Filipino Conference Siklab Series on Tuesday at Smart Araneta Coliseum. Van Sickle, who missed the PVL on Tour and the team’s breakthrough silver medal finish in the Invitationals, led the Chameleons with 11 points laced with eight digs. Myla Pablo and Jackie Acuña shone with nine points each. Jonah Sabete-Escamillan added seven points and 12 excellent receptions.
